ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the central and inner portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped to the trailing and leading edges, with significant mottling on the left lobe and a dense dark band at the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5-15 pixels. Notable deep indentations are visible on the distal third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex trajectory leading to sharp, slightly tapered lateral tips; the left tip exhibits a more pronounced upward sweep than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, parallel dark-gray linear marks (rake marks) traverse the right lobe diagonally from the inner white field toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch or minor amputation is visible on the posterior edge of the right lobe; several sets of parallel rake marks are present on the right lobe's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique dark pigmentation mark resembling an inverted 'L' or hook shape is present in the upper-central region of the left lobe's white field.
